heading: Wednesday, May 21, 2025
topLine: Mistral and All Hands AI release Devstral for agentic coding.

items.headline: Mistral and All Hands AI release Devstral for agentic coding
items.summary: Devstral is an open-weight agentic software-engineering model, built with All Hands AI, that runs on a single RTX 4090 or 32GB Mac and is released under Apache 2.0. Mistral reports 46.8% on SWE-Bench Verified, which it says led open models at release.
